description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git Large File Storage (LFS) integration with Perforce depot files. It orchestrates setup, file addition, removal, and validation of LFS functionalities based on file size, extension, and other criteria.

methods.name: test_file_in_lfs
methods.description: Validates that a specified file has been stored in Git LFS with expected content and size.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory contains an expected number of files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test step with a descriptive label that performs a sequence of shell commands and expects success.
